How it works

Three simple steps to help people notice places that matter.

01

▣ Take a photo

Capture a dirty spot that needs attention or a beautiful place worth discovering.

02

⌖ Add the location

Write the area, road, or nearby landmark so people can identify the place.

03

♡ Share respectfully

Add an optional review. Focus on the place, protect people's privacy, and be kind.
